name: swipe-row
title: Swipe Row
description: A rounded message row that drags sideways with resistance and snaps open to reveal coloured action buttons. Pull far enough and the primary action takes over, then the row collapses away.
use: A touch list needs quick per-item actions without opening a detail screen or adding visible buttons.
avoid: Sideways drags compete with browser back gestures and are awkward with a mouse; it needs pointer events.
a11y: Keyboard users get a small toggle button to open the row and delete; the drag itself is pointer-only and reduced motion is not checked. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: respected)
looks: Four dark rounded rows stacked in a column, each holding a circular initials badge, sender name, subject and timestamp. Swiping a row exposes a solid red panel on the right with a white bin icon and the word Delete.
behaves: Dragging a row sideways moves it with rubber-band give; past halfway it snaps open to show the action panel. A fast flick opens or closes it, and a long pull commits the delete and collapses the row.
customise: Actions array, action and drawer colours, row height, radius, action width, swipe direction, resistance and commit threshold are props; the row's own content is passed as children.
weight: light: One motion value per row plus a spring on release; nothing runs until a row is touched.
